documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Letters Sent To Shareholders
Notice Of The 65Th Annual General Meeting Of The Company

analysis.summary: The provided document contains garbled text and encoded characters that prevent the extraction of meaningful financial information or management commentary. No clear statements regarding guidance, demand outlook, capex, margins, orders, capital allocation, or risks could be identified. Consequently, all thematic lists are empty. Narmada Gelatines reported a 4.89% decline in revenue from operations to Rs 181.79 crore for the financial year 2023-24, while profit after tax remained stable at Rs 15.33 crore. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs 10.00 per equity share of Rs 10 each.

guidance.claim: The company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine through its technology absorption efforts.
guidance.quote: The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.

demand_outlook.claim: Awareness of the health benefits of gelatin is driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: Gelatin, being a rich source of collagen, is recognised for boosting joint health, skin elasticity, and hair strength, driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for medicines is expected to increase due to the rapid growth of the ageing population globally.
demand_outlook.quote: Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase.

demand_outlook.claim: Changing lifestyles and an increasing working population are driving demand for convenience food and beverages, which in turn drives gelatin demand.
demand_outlook.quote: There is also increasing demand for convenience food and beverages due to changing lifestyles, increasing working population as consumers lacks the time to prepare home – cooked food and are more inclined towards convenience food products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is discussing the installation of a 2 MW solar power plant within its factory premises.
capex_expansion.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.

margins_costs.claim: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1% due to better yield, and power and fuel costs reduced by 1.5% due to improved boiler efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield, power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost stood at 8.21% of revenue from operations compared to 7.17% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Employee cost stood at 8.21% (7.17% previous year) of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased to 6.35% of revenue from operations compared to 6.23% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses were on the higher side at 6.35% as compared to the previous year at 6.23% of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Profit growth was led by higher gelatin prices, better yield, and lower power and fuel consumption.
margins_costs.quote: Growth led by higher price of gelatin, better yield and lower consumption of power and fuel.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume of gelatine and DCP decreased by 5% and 8% respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing good quality raw material, specifically crushed bones, is a major concern for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes is a primary market barrier.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cultural and religious prohibitions are impeding market growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Furthermore, cultural and religious prohibitions are impeding market growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Low-cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China and blended with high-quality Indian gelatin.
risks_headwinds.quote: According to the minutes of the meeting of the Drugs Consultative Committee – there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to provide a safe, dynamic, and trustworthy environment for all its employees.
management_commitments.quote: We aim to provide a safe, dynamic, and trustworthy environment for all our employees henceforth.

management_commitments.claim: The company will constantly strive to ensure a strong corporate culture that integrates CSR values with business objectives.
management_commitments.quote: The Company shall constantly strive to ensure strong corporate culture which emphasizes on integrating CSR values with business objective.
